label: Brevo
description: Sync customers to Brevo contacts and send cart and order events for email and SMS marketing automation. Create an API key in Brevo → Settings → SMTP & API → API Keys.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the API key and the contact list

actions.label: Import existing customers
actions.hint: Creates or updates a Brevo contact for every customer account

modal.title: Import existing customers
modal.description: Creates or updates a Brevo contact for every customer account, using the current settings. Customers who opted in to email are added to the email list. The import runs in the background; large stores can take several minutes.

fields.label: Only customers who opted in to email
API key
fields.description: Brevo → Settings → SMTP & API → API Keys. Starts with xkeysib-.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns off all syncing without uninstalling the app

fields.label: Contacts
fields.description: Customer accounts are created or updated as Brevo contacts when they are created or changed in Swell.

fields.label: Sync customer accounts
fields.description: Create and update a Brevo contact for each customer account

fields.label: Email list ID
fields.description: Numeric ID of the Brevo list for customers who opt in to email marketing (Contacts → Lists → #ID). Leave empty to sync contacts without adding them to a list.

fields.label: Remove from list on opt-out
fields.description: Remove the contact from the email list when the customer turns off email marketing

fields.label: Sync phone for SMS opt-ins
fields.description: Set the contact's SMS attribute when the customer opts in to SMS marketing and has a valid phone number

fields.label: First name attribute
fields.description: Brevo contact attribute for the first name

fields.label: Last name attribute
fields.description: Brevo contact attribute for the last name

fields.label: Events
fields.description: Events are sent to Brevo with the customer's email and can trigger automations.

fields.label: checkout_started
fields.description: Sent when a cart is created

fields.label: cart_abandoned
fields.description: Sent when a cart is abandoned

fields.label: order_submitted
fields.description: Sent when an order is placed

fields.label: order_fulfilled
fields.description: Sent when an order is delivered

fields.label: order_canceled
fields.description: Sent when an order is canceled

fields.label: Sync orders to Brevo eCommerce
fields.description: Send orders to Brevo eCommerce for revenue reporting and segmentation. Activate eCommerce in Brevo first (Brevo → eCommerce).
